explanation_en: On ball 2.3, Mohammed Shami took the wicket of Rahmanullah Gurbaz! Your player Mohammed Shami gained +25.0 points, increasing your total to 434.5, but your rank dropped by 6 to 753 because other teams in the pool gained more points on this ball.

watch_next_en: Keep an eye on Rinku Singh and Sunil Narine, who both need 30 more runs for their 30-run milestone bonus!
